versionImpact.rationale: The release adds the kungfu-native-linux-x64 source builder and comparator-formal-runner evidence distribution contracts without changing existing image identities.

surfaceImpacts.rationale: The image family gains an exact-digest host-extracted runner with a frozen balanced schedule, formal-performance schemas, symmetric cgroup-v2 resource contracts, and a fail-closed offline verifier that cannot assign a product winner.
The image family gains a dedicated linux/amd64 Kungfu source-build environment with pinned GCC 14, Node 22 bootstrap, Python/uv, Conan, and Rust 1.96 tooling plus a build-only evidence contract.
The existing v1.2 image family now uses the standard Buildchain v2.12 alpha and stable router with separate locked contracts and unchanged image identifiers.
The existing Node 24 image exposes the repository-declared pnpm toolchain through Corepack without removing or renaming an existing runtime surface.
The existing LaTeX image adds scalable CM-Super fonts so microtype font expansion works with the default Computer Modern family while preserving existing TeX entrypoints.
Stable publication now supplies the required surface impact ledger to the Buildchain release passport without changing the published OCI family contract.

The comparator pilot prepares exact-digest images in a retained unscored phase with bounded transient retries, prevents pulls during all 63 formal PostgreSQL steps, derives J1/J2/J3 receipts from retained observed facts, and preserves semantic verification, project-scoped cleanup, adapter mappings, and published image identifiers.
